comment: The gate knob's 0 to 10 range has a floor applied in process(): anything above 0 and below 0.2 is raised to 0.2, so custom gates run 0.2 to 10 seconds. The README gives 0.1 to 10 seconds in its body text and 0.2 to 10 in its bullet list. RTRIG blocks a retrigger when true and allows one when false, so the menu item named Global Retrig disables retriggering. The auto-name index is floor(random::uniform() * 10) into a 21-entry table. The trigger sum also fires on a large negative voltage, because the total is tested at 1 and at -1.
